items.title: Dwa wywołania jednego eksperymentu mogą użyć różnych poświadczeń

evidence.observed: Request1 uses synthetic A; public ApiKeyStore mutation between requests; request2 uses synthetic B. Real ViewModel → Runner → Agent → Retrofit returns INSTRUMENT_OK and real ResearchRepository inserts that record into the test DAO. sourceProvenanceProbes is [].
evidence.scope: Actual consumers and serialization, in-memory Android preferences/lifecycle/DAO; no actual billing or Android persistence claim.

items.acceptance_test: Run same host probe. Unchanged credentials produce two A requests and INSTRUMENT_OK; replace credentials after first capture: preserve operation authority with two A requests or explicitly stop after one and record failure/cancellation, never A+B. Clear still forbids second request.
items.target_data_graph: MethodRun → execution authorization reference + revision + effective request/recipe reference; secret material stays outside public graph payload.
items.migration_risk: Do not backfill old results with invented account provenance. Snapshot must not turn revocation into continued sending; use opaque handles/epochs, not raw API keys in evidence.
dependencies: Execution context shared across runner and agent

evidence.observed: Hold real Retrofit listModels response for synthetic A in interceptor, call real clearApiKey/saveApiKey(B), then release response. Models become [models/page-1], message Live registry: 1 models discovered; rekey case captured only A, no B refresh.
evidence.scope: Actual ViewModel StateFlow methods; Compose consumers inspected, not rendered.

items.acceptance_test: Delay response for A, clear: no old models or live-success status restored. Delay A, save B: old response cannot become B registry; new B response or explicit unavailable state. Same unchanged A refresh remains usable.
items.target_data_graph: ModelRegistrySnapshot → provider/authorization nonsecret revision + acquisition status; selected current snapshot distinct from historical snapshot.
items.migration_risk: In-memory registry state can be invalidated without schema migration. Never label old account snapshots as current; keep historical provenance only if deliberately supported.
dependencies: Refresh cancellation/fencing and current-state publication rule

ageds: No new product fix from passing reviewed mechanisms. Prior findings remain independently open.
